Flow UV U is downstream cumulative metre station, V signed lateral distance. Shared graph junctions have matched stations; this is static UV data without animation, current velocity, fluid physics, buoyancy or particle lifetimes.

They require an explicit rebuild after editing dependencies; no live scene dependency graph is implemented.

170 semantic roles keep bark, root heartwood, deep soil, waterworn rock, flow, fall, foam and distant proxy rock independent. Water/foam are noncollision and zero-emission. The reference material palette supplies alpha; flat inspection deliberately renders opaque colour.

Near/far/day/night/close images are real editor captures in SwiftShader software WebGL. Day/night captures use the original flat-colour palette under editor lighting; separate per-asset and per-scene material previews inspect PBR and transparent water. No hardware GPU or game-clock integration is claimed.

All 324 reference candidates remain pending human artistic acceptance. Component variants, source/surface pieces, individual stones, and auxiliary union assets do not add catalogue masters.
